During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a prominent [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''colonel''' sought to bid anonymously on the stolen lounging slippers of the popular singer [[Wi'looa]], which were an item in a black market auction.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Closet Collector}}</ref>
